messages:
Zane: Quick sync — PR #5123 (fusion of flash+paged kernels) landed, can we run a small smoke+profiling sweep on canary infra? Need batch sizes [1,8,32], seq [128,512,2048], model: gpt-small, mode: fused. Please capture p50/p95, peak alloc, and nvtx/nsys traces where possible. Ideally run both fused and unfused (master) and upload artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/5123-smoke. @Maria @Devon :eyes:

Devon: I can run this tonight on gpu-canary-3. Which binary should I use? Is this the kernel build attached to the PR or the upstream compiled build? Also do we want fp16-only runs or fp32 baseline too?

Maria: happy to run. I grabbed the PR build tarball at: gs://ci-artifacts/pr-5123/fuse-build.tar.gz. I'll spin up a node and run a minimal script: ```bash
export S3_PREFIX=s3://redwood-perf/5123-smoke/$HOST
./run_perf.sh --model gpt-small --batches 1,8,32 --seqs 128,512,2048 --modes fused,unfused --profile nsys --collect-kernel-timings
``` 

Sasha: For profiling, collect: `nsys profile --output ${S3_PREFIX}/trace` (captures cpu/gpu timeline) and also `nvprof --csv --log-file` if you need kernel CSVs. Grab `dmesg` and `nvidia-smi dmon` for power/temp. Put logs under `${S3_PREFIX}/logs` and traces under `${S3_PREFIX}/traces`. Also include `LD_PRELOAD` stack if using patched allocators.

ci-bot: created job perf-sweep-5123-1901234568, queued on gpu-canary-3 :rocket:

Kai: Quick note — I saw a ~6% p95 regression on seq=2048 batch=1 with fusion in an isolated micro-run earlier. Looks like an extra memcpy at the tail of the attention kernel (probably L2 spill). I'll attach the small trace when I have it.

Maria: initial quick-run numbers from gpu-canary-3 (fused vs unfused): ```
seq=128 batch=8: fused p50=12.3ms p95=18.9ms (unfused p95=19.5ms)
seq=512 batch=8: fused p50=34.1ms p95=47.5ms (unfused p95=46.9ms)
seq=2048 batch=1: fused p50=210ms p95=360ms (unfused p95=338ms)
``` full traces uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/5123-smoke/gpu-canary-3/

Zane: thanks — @Kai can you attach that trace and the tiny repro? If it's a kernel-level regression, please open an issue and tag `area/runtime/attention` and `regression`, and link PR#5123. We'll triage after sweep.

Devon: kicking off full sweep now, ETA ~45m. I'll also run with `FLASH_ATTENTION_DISABLE_PREFETCH=1` and with `FLASH_ATTENTION_PREFETCH_LINES=32` to check prefetch knobs.

Sasha: also add `--workload-label pr-5123-smoke` to the run script so artifacts are easy to find. For perf metrics, capture p50/p90/p95, throughput (tokens/s), GPU memory high-water, and percent SM utilization.

Maria: added the flags, new run started. I'll follow up when uploads finish. :thumbsup:

Zane: plan — collect all artifacts, synthesize a short perf summary, and open a perf issue with traces + a one-paragraph summary. If the regression is <5% we'll allow canary rollout; if >=5% block and revert PR until fix. Thanks all for the fast turnaround.
